title: Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration
breadcrumb: Solutions > Growth & Revenue > Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration
meta_description: Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration — composed architecture, platform stack and the metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration exists because a specific failure keeps repeating: attribution wars persist because measurement infrastructure doesn't exist; creative production bottlenecks on manual cycles; CX signals from service and product never join the marketing loop.
Attribution wars persist because measurement infrastructure doesn't exist; creative production bottlenecks on manual cycles; CX signals from service and product never join the marketing loop.

The pattern behind Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration: decisions that should be systematized are still assembled by hand — one document, one queue, one meeting at a time. This solution replaces the assembly with a governed composition.

We deploy clean-room measurement with test-and-holdout discipline, build the creative factory under brand guardrails, and orchestrate CX signals (contact drivers, churn intents) into campaign and product actions.
In Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration, the components, as they land:

items: variant generation with brand guardrails and QC
service and product signals into targeting
holdout discipline on every major spend

blocks.x: Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration composes EEMS Platform, Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Retail & Consumer Goods, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Technology & SaaS, Media.

Method over magic in Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration: the problem gets a CFO-unit statement and a signed baseline; the design gets a written risk envelope; the pilot gets falsifiable criteria; the rollout gets whatever the evidence supports. What we promise is modest and checkable: a signed baseline, a bounded slice in production, and evidence your auditors can read without a guide.

Every Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration value case is written against named movements; the list below is the shape of that case, priced against your baseline during the diagnostic — never a promise from a brochure.
Bring Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration to a 45-minute briefing with the practice lead — your metric, our method, and an honest read on feasibility.
